verdict.rationale: Workable documents a broad API covering jobs, candidates (create, list, rate), offers, stages, requisitions, member invites, department merges, events and webhooks, and its MCP server claims access across the "entire hiring lifecycle." However, several documented UI capabilities have no API evidence, and some objects are read-only through the API: stages are defined on the recruiting preferences page, permission sets are list-only, and API scopes are enabled through the Settings UI. Missing for 10: API evidence for UI features such as the careers page builder, custom report builder, 200+ job-board posting, AI sourcing/recommendations and translation; write access for configuration objects like stages and permission sets; a published OpenAPI spec (all probed spec paths returned 404); independent confirmation of parity.
